## The claim

The disease mechanism in this proband is hypomorphic loss of BUB1B function: one null allele (stop_gained, exon 17 of 23) plus one partly functional allele (kinase-domain missense), leaving reduced BubR1 and a leaky spindle assembly checkpoint; there is no gain-of-function or dominant-negative component.

**Prediction if true.** Public sources agree with the shape: ClinVar and the literature classify BUB1B MVA1 as autosomal recessive loss of function; every reported MVA1 genotype combines a null with a hypomorph or two hypomorphs; no BUB1B variant is annotated dominant or gain-of-function in ClinVar/OMIM; Reactome places BUB1B in the mitotic spindle checkpoint pathway.

**What would refute it.** Any ClinVar or OMIM record of a dominant or gain-of-function BUB1B mechanism, functional evidence that kinase-domain missense alleles act as dominant negatives, or the oracle returning no match for the BUB1B pair (which would make the mechanism argument moot).
